featured_reviews.name: Nitin Pundge
featured_reviews.review_text: "Mera is school ke saath anubhav bahut nirashajanak raha. Mujhe meri beti ki books lene ke liye 10 minute rukne ko kaha gaya, lekin main lagbhag aadha ghanta intezar karta raha. Uske baad mujhe bataya gaya ki books abhi nahi milengi. Agar books dena sambhav nahi tha, to pehle hi spasht bata dena chahiye tha, jisse mera samay barbaad na hota. Jab main is baare mein office mein puchhne gaya, to cashier ne bhi bahut rude aur asammanjanak tareeke se baat ki. School management ko staff ke vyavahar aur parents ke saath communication par dhyan dene ki zarurat hai."
featured_reviews.review_translated_text: "My experience with this school was very disappointing. I was asked to wait for 10 minutes to collect my daughter's books, but I waited for almost half an hour. I was then told that the books would not be available yet. If it was not possible to provide the books, they should have made it clear in advance so that my time would not be wasted. When I went to the office to inquire about this, the cashier also spoke to me in a very rude and disrespectful manner. The school management needs to pay attention to the behavior of the staff and communication with parents."
